plugins.name: dispatch-board
plugins.description: Your AI eng manager for Claude Code. It runs your plan on native loops, dispatches what's ready, and brings you the calls that need you.

skills.name: dispatch-gate
skills.description: The consequence-gated dispatch contract at the heart of the harness. Use this whenever you need to decide whether an in-flight or ready board card should be dispatched, escalated to the human, or left alone — i.e. on every tick, or whenever the plan changes and existing cards may have gone stale. Explains the FIRE/ASK/SILENT verdict model, the default heuristic gate, and how to swap in a custom gate (e.g. a consequence-weighted model) without changing the harness.
headings: Lint — the schema is enforced, not suggested

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Closes the learning loop the other agent boards skip. Use this after a run, a milestone, or an overnight session to produce a plan-vs-actual retro — what the plan said, what actually happened, where the gate fired/asked/silenced, and what to change. Trigger whenever the user asks for a retro, a post-mortem, "what happened overnight", or wants to tune the board or the gate thresholds.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Bootstrap the harness in this repo — create the running plan and an empty board from one problem statement.

commands.name: kanban
commands.description: Open the live kanban visualizer for this repo's board in the browser — verdict-colored columns, triage rail, auto-refresh.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run the board on Claude Code's native loop — tick on an interval until the board is drained, leaving the ASK queue for the human. Local, no cron.
headings: What `/loop` actually guarantees — read before running overnight

commands.name: status
commands.description: Render the board, per-card spend, and the current ASK queue.

commands.name: triage
commands.description: Run one dispatch cycle — re-evaluate every card through the gate, then dispatch what should fire.

headings: Why not just use a kanban board?
How it works (all native Claude Code primitives)
The gate is pluggable — bring your own brain
exports:  verdict(card, ctx) -> { verdict: "FIRE"|"ASK"|"SILENT", reason: string }
